agb.title: General Terms and Conditions for Insurance Brokers
agb.subtitle: Healio GmbH – General Terms and Conditions for Insurance Brokers.
agb.section1Title: 1. Subject of Contract per Broker Agreement
agb.section1p1: The insurance broker agreement, incorporating these General Terms and Conditions (GTC), applies only to the private-law insurance contracts expressly named in the broker agreement for which brokerage services were requested or management was transferred to the broker.
agb.section1p2: It may be separately agreed that the mandate extends to insurance relationships existing at the time of conclusion of this agreement.
agb.section1p3: No other or further obligation to act or advise exists beyond the scope defined herein.
agb.section1p4: If the client concludes an insurance contract through another intermediary after the conclusion of this agreement, the present broker agreement does not extend to that contract.
agb.section1p5: If the client wishes the broker to arrange an additional insurance contract after conclusion of the present broker agreement, the present broker agreement also extends to this advice.
agb.section1p6: This insurance broker agreement relates only to the advice on and brokerage of insurance contracts pursuant to §34d GewO.
agb.section2Text: The client is obligated to cooperate, in particular to provide truthful information promptly and completely.
agb.section3Text: The broker assumes liability for the proper fulfilment of duties within the framework of statutory provisions.

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.intro: We take the protection of your personal data very seriously. We treat your personal data as confidential and in accordance with applicable data protection laws and this Privacy Policy.
datenschutz.section1Text: The party responsible for data processing on this website is:
datenschutz.serverLogsText: The hosting provider automatically collects and stores information in server log files that your browser automatically sends to us. This information comprises browser type and version, the operating system used, referrer URL, host name of the accessing computer, time of the server request and IP address.
datenschutz.contactFormText: When you contact us through a form, we process the details you enter so that we can handle your enquiry and respond to follow-up questions. The next section explains the delivery provider used for this purpose.
datenschutz.emailJsTitle: Sending contact and pet insurance forms via EmailJS
datenschutz.emailJsText: We send form enquiries to our inbox through the email delivery provider EmailJS (EmailJS Pte. Ltd., Singapore). Depending on the form, the data may include your name, email address, telephone number, practice or company and the content of your message. For the pet health-insurance form, it includes your name and email address as well as the animal profile: animal type, cover requested, age, optional breed and, for horses, the stated use. We also document the plan-review commission with its version and time and the confirmation of the privacy notice. We process these details to handle your enquiry, carry out the commissioned plan review and reply to you. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR where the enquiry concerns pre-contractual steps or the commissioned review and advice; otherwise it is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, based on our legitimate interest in handling incoming enquiries efficiently. EmailJS processes the data as a processor and states that it may store request data and metadata. Personal data may be transferred to the United States; EmailJS cites Standard Contractual Clauses as a safeguard for European users. We retain your enquiry only for as long as needed to handle it and comply with statutory retention duties.
datenschutz.leitfadenText: If you submit the form on the page “Guide for practices” (healio.de/partner/leitfaden), we process the data entered there in order to provide the guide and to contact you about it. We process: first name, email address, phone number (optional), type of practice, the time of the request and technical data (a shortened browser identifier, a non-reversible hash of the IP address and, where present, campaign parameters of the URL). Storage takes place with Supabase Inc. as processor in the EU region Frankfurt. The legal basis is your consent under Art. 6 (1) (a) GDPR. You may withdraw it at any time with effect for the future, for example by email to info@healio.de. We delete the data as soon as the purpose no longer applies, at the latest after withdrawal, unless a statutory retention period applies.
datenschutz.appPointer: Information about our Healio Tree app and about enquiries sent from the app can be found under
datenschutz.appIntro: Our app Healio Tree performs its calculations on your device. It stores your details, scenarios and settings as well as a copy of your prepared enquiries on your device. The app is configured to exclude these data from device cloud backups. It is currently not connected to any Healio server and does not automatically transmit your inputs to Healio. Healio cannot access the calculation values stored in the app. The app never adds your situation, details from the introduction, amounts, calculation results or variants to an enquiry. Anything you voluntarily write in the free-text field becomes part of the enquiry. With “Alle Angaben löschen” (delete all details) in the settings, you remove the data stored by the app, including local copies of your enquiries. This does not delete messages already sent from their recipients.
datenschutz.appNoTracking: The app does not require a user account. It contains no advertising networks and no analytics or tracking services. At the end of certain areas, there is a contact route for Healio’s own services, explicitly labelled as advertising. The explanatory chat is switched off.
datenschutz.appStores: If you download the app from Apple's App Store or from Google Play, the respective provider processes data such as your account and the time of the download under its own responsibility. Apple's and Google's privacy notices apply to this. If you have allowed crash reports to be shared with app developers in your device settings, the store provider may make such reports available to us.
datenschutz.appLinks: If you tap a link to a website in the app, your browser or the relevant app opens. The privacy policy of the website you visit applies there.
datenschutz.appRequestTitle: Enquiries from the app by email
datenschutz.appRequestText: From the app, you can prepare a voluntary enquiry about our own topics, investing money or capital investments, or finding a tax advisory firm. The app opens your email program with a prepared email to info@healio.de or offers the text via your device’s share menu. You decide which route to use and what to send. The app does not send the enquiry itself. Healio receives the information contained in your email only when your email arrives. Beforehand, the app displays the wording of your consent and a privacy notice. A copy of the prepared enquiry remains on your device so that you can later prepare a withdrawal. This copy does not establish that the message was actually sent.
datenschutz.appRequestChannel: We accept enquiries from the app only by email to info@healio.de, not via WhatsApp. If you nevertheless write to us there, only the information under “Contact via WhatsApp” applies. Your message is not recorded as an enquiry there, and no one at Healio is notified automatically. We do not pass on details from your enquiry to third parties without your agreement. The only exceptions are service providers working on our behalf and cases in which a law obliges us to disclose them.
datenschutz.appRequestHealth: Please do not include any information about your health in your message. Where necessary, we clarify such questions in a conversation.
datenschutz.appHealioTitle: Enquiries about insurance, pensions and protection
datenschutz.appHealioText: For enquiries about health insurance, supplementary insurance, pensions and retirement, company pension or company health insurance (bAV or bKV) and protection, we process the details from your email: your concern and your message, your first name, your telephone number and your email address, as far as you provide them, your contact preference with preferred times and preferred appointment, where in the app the enquiry comes from (area, branch and screen, the topic only if you choose to send it), the version, wording and time of your consent, the version of the initial information (Erstinformation) that the app showed you before the form, an enquiry identifier, the name and version of the app, and your sender address and the time of your email. The app never adds your situation, details from the introduction, amounts, calculation results or variants. Information you voluntarily write in your message is part of your enquiry.
datenschutz.appHealioPurpose: The purpose is to call you or write to you about your concern and, if you wish, to arrange an appointment with you. We do not use these details for newsletters or advertising. Providing your details is voluntary. Without contact details, however, we cannot get back to you. The legal basis is your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR. If your enquiry leads to an engagement, we process the details required for it in order to prepare and perform the contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
datenschutz.anlageTitle: Enquiries about investing money and capital investments, disclosure to cooperation partners
datenschutz.anlageText: We accept enquiries about investing money or about capital investments by email to info@healio.de. Our app Healio Tree prepares such an email for you; you send it yourself. We then process the details from this email: your concern and your message, your first name, your email address and, if you provide it, your telephone number, your contact preference with preferred times and preferred appointment, where in the app the enquiry comes from (area, branch and screen, the topic only if you choose to send it), the version, wording and time of the consent you gave in the app, an enquiry identifier and the name and version of the app, as well as your sender address and the time of your email. The app never adds your situation, your details from the introduction or amounts to this enquiry. The purpose is to get back to you and to clarify with you whether you would like to speak to a cooperation partner. Healio does not itself advise on investments and does not broker them. Providing your details is voluntary. Without contact details, however, we cannot get back to you.
datenschutz.anlageContact: We first reply to your email. If you have given a telephone number, we only call you once you have confirmed in your reply that the enquiry comes from you.
datenschutz.anlageLegalBasis: The legal basis is your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR. This applies to the consent in the app, with which you allow us to store your details and to call you or write to you about your enquiry. It applies equally to your separate agreement to your enquiry being passed on to a cooperation partner. We keep the record of your consent because Section 7a of the German Act against Unfair Competition (UWG) requires us to do so. The legal basis for this is Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.
datenschutz.anlageRecipients: Recipients of your details may be financial investment intermediaries licensed under Section 34f of the German Trade Regulation Act (GewO) and real estate brokers licensed under Section 34c(1) sentence 1 no. 1 GewO with whom we cooperate. We pass on your enquiry only with your agreement. Beforehand, we tell you in a conversation the cooperation partner’s company name and licence. We tell you which details we would pass on, namely first name, contact details, preferred time and topic, never your message. We also ask whether the partner may call you and inform you that you can withdraw your agreement at any time. We then summarise this in an email to you and pass the enquiry on only after you have confirmed that email. Together with the enquiry, the cooperation partner receives a copy of your confirmation so that it can prove your consent itself. From receipt onwards, the partner is itself responsible for your details. The cooperation partner’s own privacy information applies to processing by it.
datenschutz.anlageProcessors: Technical service providers process your details only on our behalf. Currently this is the provider of our email mailbox. Details are given under “Mailbox, retention and record of consent”.
datenschutz.anlageStorage: We delete your enquiry and the email with which you sent it as soon as we have passed the enquiry on, otherwise after 180 days at the latest. Separately, we keep the record of your consent for five years, in the case of disclosure together with the recipient and your confirmation (Section 7a(2) UWG).
datenschutz.anlageRevocation: You may likewise withdraw your agreement to the disclosure at any time with effect for the future. If your enquiry has already been passed on, we forward your withdrawal to the cooperation partner and ask it to delete your details.
datenschutz.kanzleiTitle: Enquiries “Steuerberater gesucht” (tax advisor wanted), disclosure to a tax advisory firm
datenschutz.kanzleiText: If you choose the concern “Steuerberater gesucht” (tax advisor wanted) in our app Healio Tree, the app prepares an email to info@healio.de; you send it yourself. We then process the details from this email: your concern and your message, your first name, your email address and, if you provide it, your telephone number, your contact or appointment preference with preferred times and preferred appointment, where in the app the enquiry comes from (area, branch and screen, the topic only if you choose to send it), the version, wording and time of your consent, an enquiry identifier, the name and version of the app, and your sender address and the time of your email. Your answers to “Was brauchst du?” (What do you need?) and “Ich bin ...” (I am ...) are only included if you select them yourself. The app never adds your situation, details from the introduction, amounts, calculation results or variants to this enquiry. Information you voluntarily write in your message is part of your enquiry.
datenschutz.kanzleiPurpose: The purpose is to show you ways to a tax advisory firm and, if you wish, to pass your enquiry on to the firm you have chosen yourself. We do not use these details for insurance offers. We do not advise on tax matters, and we receive no money for the contact. We first reply to your email and only call you once you have confirmed this. The legal basis is your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR and, for the disclosure, your separate agreement.
datenschutz.kanzleiRecipients: The only possible recipient is the tax advisory firm you have chosen yourself, and only if you agree and confirm this by email. We then pass on your first name, contact details, appointment preference, topic and, if you selected them yourself, your answers to “Was brauchst du?” and “Ich bin ...”. From receipt onwards, the firm is itself responsible for your details.
datenschutz.kanzleiStorage: We delete your enquiry and the email with which you sent it when we pass it on, otherwise after 180 days at the latest. Separately, we keep the record of your consent for five years, in the case of disclosure together with the recipient and your confirmation. If your enquiry has already been passed on, we forward a withdrawal to the firm and ask it to delete your details.
datenschutz.mailboxTitle: Mailbox, retention and record of consent
datenschutz.appMailbox: Enquiries from the app arrive in our mailbox info@healio.de. We operate this mailbox with Google Workspace, a service of Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland. Google processes the emails on our behalf. Google may also process data outside the EU, for example in the USA. Depending on the transfer, safeguards may include in particular the adequacy decision for the EU-US Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses.
datenschutz.appStorage: We file each enquiry email in a separate folder for enquiries in the mailbox. It remains there until your enquiry has been dealt with, for no more than 180 days. If we pass an enquiry on to a cooperation partner or a tax advisory firm, we delete the enquiry and the email when we pass it on. If an enquiry about our own topics leads to an engagement, we transfer only the details required for it to our customer records, which are subject to the statutory retention periods. If you tell us that an enquiry does not come from you, we delete the enquiry and the record immediately.
datenschutz.appProof: Separately, we create a record of your consent in a second folder. This is a shortened extract of your email containing sender, recipient, date and subject, the wording, version and time of your consent, the enquiry identifier, your first name and your contact details (email address and, if provided, telephone number). Your message, your situation and your details are not part of it. We also note there when we called you or wrote to you, in the case of disclosure the recipient, the details passed on and your agreement, and, where applicable, your withdrawal. We keep this record for five years, counted from your consent and anew after each use. Section 7a of the German Act against Unfair Competition (UWG) obliges us to do so. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.
datenschutz.appRevocation: You may withdraw your consent from the app at any time with effect for the future by email to info@healio.de. Under Einstellungen (Settings), you can prepare a withdrawal text for your email program or the share menu for each saved enquiry. You must send it to Healio yourself; we can process it once it has arrived. This does not affect the lawfulness of processing carried out before the withdrawal. After your withdrawal, we delete your enquiry and the email with which you sent it, unless it has led to an engagement. We keep the record of your consent together with your withdrawal for the period stated above. “Alle Angaben löschen” (delete all details) removes the local copy of the enquiry and the associated template but does not send a withdrawal. You can still write directly to info@healio.de. Your further rights are set out in the following section.
datenschutz.hostingText: This website is hosted by Vercel Inc. (United States) and delivered through the content delivery network of Cloudflare Inc. (United States). Technically necessary connection data, including IP addresses, is processed to provide the website and protect it against attacks. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in secure and high-performance operation under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR. We have data processing agreements incorporating EU Standard Contractual Clauses with both providers.
datenschutz.analyticsText: Google Analytics 4 (Google Ireland Ltd.) is loaded only after you have expressly consented to analytics. Once enabled, usage data such as pages viewed and time spent on the site may be processed; according to Google, Google Analytics 4 does not store individual IP addresses. The resulting statistics help us improve our services. The legal basis for processing is your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR. You may withdraw that consent at any time with effect for the future through the privacy settings. No analytics data is transferred to Google Analytics before you consent.
datenschutz.googleAdsText: Only if you switch on “Marketing (Google Ads and Meta)” in the cookie banner and a Google Ads account is configured do we load the conversion tag of Google Ads, a service provided by Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland. The sole purpose is to measure whether our ads lead to enquiries and opened applications. An enquiry is a submitted contact form or a click on the link that opens our appointment calendar directly in Google Calendar; whether you then book an appointment there is not measured. An opened application is a click on an insurer's application or premium calculator. What is transmitted is the event, the page viewed, the time, the ad click identifier (GCLID) and the Google cookies _gcl_au and _gcl_aw. Contents of calculators, selection aids or forms, names and email addresses are not transmitted. If you submit our contact form after clicking an ad, we send the click identifier with your enquiry to our mailbox so that we can attribute a later contract to the right ad; this too happens only with your marketing consent. No advertising personalisation takes place; that setting remains switched off permanently. We never load Google Ads on our pregnancy page or in our pregnancy guides. If you arrive there via an ad and continue to a tariff page, the link only carries the ad click identifier. Measurement only happens on the tariff page, and Google only learns its address without additions, so neither the page you came from nor any campaign or entry codes. The legal basis is your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR and Section 25(1) TDDDG. You can withdraw it at any time via the cookie settings in the footer; after that we no longer send conversion events and delete the cookies. Google also processes data in the United States; Google LLC is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Further information: https://policies.google.com/privacy and https://business.safety.google/adscookies/.
datenschutz.metaText: Only if you switch on “Marketing (Google Ads and Meta)” in the cookie banner do we use the Meta pixel provided by Meta Platforms Ireland Limited, Merrion Road, Dublin 4, Ireland, and additionally transmit the same events server side via the Conversions API. The purpose is to measure whether our ads on Facebook and Instagram lead to page views, calculator starts and enquiries, and to build audiences for renewed contact. What is transmitted is the event name, the page viewed, the time, a random event ID, IP address and browser identifier as well as the Meta cookies _fbp and _fbc. Contents of calculators, selection aids or forms, names and email addresses are not transmitted. The legal basis is your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR and Section 25(1) TDDDG. You can withdraw it at any time via the cookie settings in the footer; after that we no longer use the pixel and delete the cookies. Meta also processes data in the United States; Meta Platforms, Inc. is certified under the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. Further information: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy and https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policies/cookies. The Meta controller addendum applies to the joint controllership for event collection: https://www.facebook.com/legal/controller_addendum.
datenschutz.nitaText: Nita’s voice connection is provided through OpenAI and starts only after your express consent. No audio data is transferred to OpenAI before it starts. The legal basis is your consent under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR. You may withdraw that consent at any time with effect for the future through the privacy settings. Please do not share sensitive health data with Nita. Personal advice is available through the contact channels listed on this website.
datenschutz.calendarText: Embedded appointment booking through Google Calendar loads only after your separate consent. Google then receives technical connection data, particularly your IP address and browser information. You may withdraw this consent at any time with effect for the future through our privacy settings. When you book, the details you enter, such as your name, email address and chosen appointment, are processed through Google Calendar and made available to us to organise the appointment. The legal basis for loading the embed is Article 6(1)(a) GDPR; for the appointment you request, it is Article 6(1)(b) GDPR. Meetings take place through Google Meet; booking an appointment does not authorise a recording.
datenschutz.brevoText: We use Brevo (Sendinblue GmbH, Germany) to send information emails. Your email address is used for this purpose only if you have consented or an existing business relationship applies. You can unsubscribe at any time through the unsubscribe link.
datenschutz.insurerFlowsText: For premium calculators and online applications, we link to journeys provided by the respective insurers, for example SDK, die Bayerische and UKV/Versicherungskammer. The privacy policies of the relevant provider apply there; the insurer processes the data entered there as the controller.
datenschutz.section3Text: Within the framework of the statutory requirements, you have the right to obtain information free of charge about your personal data stored by us (Article 15 GDPR) and the rights to rectification (Article 16 GDPR), erasure (Article 17 GDPR), restriction of processing (Article 18 GDPR) and data portability (Article 20 GDPR). Where we base processing on our legitimate interest (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR), you may object to it at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation (Article 21 GDPR). You may withdraw any consent you have given at any time with effect for the future (Article 7(3) GDPR). To do so, write to us at info@healio.de. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Article 77 GDPR). The authority responsible for us is the Hamburg Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information (Der Hamburgische Beauftragte für Datenschutz und Informationsfreiheit), Ludwig-Erhard-Straße 22, 20459 Hamburg.
datenschutz.section4Text: Our website uses cookies in some areas. Cookies do not damage your computer and do not contain viruses. They help make our services more user-friendly, effective and secure. Cookies are small text files stored on your computer by your browser.
datenschutz.section5Text: If you have any questions about data protection, please send us an email:
datenschutz.ebookRequestText: On some pages you can request free materials (e-books). For this we collect your name, e-mail address and, optionally, the name of your practice or company. The details are transmitted to us via our e-mail service provider so that we can assign your request and contact you personally if you wish. The download is available immediately after submission. The legal basis is your consent under Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR, which you can withdraw at any time with effect for the future, for example by e-mail to info@healio.de. You will not be added to a newsletter list. The data is deleted as soon as it is no longer required for processing and no statutory retention obligations apply.
datenschutz.bonusGuideTitle: Health insurance bonus guide before the premium calculator
datenschutz.bonusGuideText: When you request the health insurance bonus guide before opening an external premium calculator, we process your first name, email address, the tariff page visited, the chosen application journey and the time. We use these details to assign your request and send you the guide once by email. Your request and delivery task are stored in our own Healio contact system on our Hetzner server; delivery uses our configured email service. Answers from tariff checks and health information are not transmitted through this form. Your browser stores only a flag for the current session indicating that you have already requested the materials. Your name and email address are not stored in the browser for this purpose. Submitting the form requests this one-time delivery; you are not subscribed to a newsletter. We delete the data when it is no longer required to handle your request and no statutory retention obligations apply. For questions or a deletion request, contact info@healio.de.

lawPanel.primaryText: Mandatory information at the first business contact and the form in which it is provided.
lawPanel.secondaryText: Basis of product selection and disclosure where the selection is restricted.

nav.advisoryBasis: Basis of advice under section 60 VVG

status.title: Type of activity, permission and intermediary register
status.type: Healio GmbH is registered with the Hamburg Chamber of Commerce as an insurance broker with permission pursuant to section 34d(1) of the German Trade Regulation Act (GewO) and is entered in the intermediary register under registration number D-C1LE-OVLQH-98. The entry can be verified at www.vermittlerregister.info.
status.registryOfficeTitle: Joint register office pursuant to section 11a GewO

advice.title: Advice and type of remuneration
advice.offered: Healio GmbH offers advice in connection with the brokerage of insurance contracts.
advice.remuneration: For brokering and servicing insurance contracts, Healio GmbH exclusively receives commission or brokerage from the insurance company. This remuneration is included in the insurance premium.
advice.noOtherRemuneration: Customers do not pay any separate direct remuneration to Healio GmbH. No additional remuneration, other benefits or combination of different types of remuneration is received.

participations.title: Shareholdings
participations.outbound: Healio GmbH has no direct or indirect shareholding in the voting rights or capital of any insurance company.
participations.inbound: No insurance company or parent company of an insurance company has any direct or indirect shareholding in the voting rights or capital of Healio GmbH.

dispute.title: Addresses of the dispute resolution bodies
dispute.intro: In the event of disputes arising from insurance brokerage, consumers may contact the following recognised dispute resolution bodies:

advisoryBasis.title: Basis of advice pursuant to section 60 VVG
advisoryBasis.lead: Section 60 VVG governs the basis of our advice, not the status-related initial information.
advisoryBasis.text: As an insurance broker, we generally base our recommendation on a sufficient number of insurance contracts and insurers available on the market, allowing us to recommend, on the basis of professional criteria, which contract is suitable to meet your needs.
advisoryBasis.restricted: If, in an individual case, a recommendation is not based on a sufficient breadth of the market, we will expressly inform you before you submit your contractual declaration about the restricted selection of insurers and contracts, the market and information basis used and the insurers taken into account.

erstinformation.closing: This information is provided free of charge. Please retain it for your records. Your browser's print function allows you to print the page or save it as a PDF.
